summary: -i is parsed into iterations and bounds the timed spmvCpu loop. Rank 0 builds partitions sequentially from firstRow=0, sets the last rank's endRow to numRows, and advances firstRow to each endRow; the contiguous ranges therefore cover all rows. Compiled timed code has the outer iteration back edge as well as CSR-entry loads, multiply/add accumulation, output stores, and row-loop back edges. No omitted or hoisted timed iterations identified.

source_evidence.claim: -i sets iterations. Partition generation carries each endRow forward as the next firstRow and terminates the last partition at numRows; scattered row/nonzero ranges are reconstructed locally. The timed loop calls spmvCpu iterations times over localRows; each call traverses CSR entries and stores each row result.

compiled_evidence.claim: In the measured main path, the emitted code loops over local rows and CSR entries, loads the indexed vector and CSR value, multiplies and accumulates, stores the row result, increments and compares the timed iteration counter, then branches back. The compiled spmvCpu routine also contains inner and outer loop back edges and output stores.
